description: Use this first when the user mentions their 3dCMS scenes, a site they built with 3dCMS, or wants to edit, publish or check something they made. Lists the 3D scenes saved in their 3dCMS account (editable "sources"), newest first, 40 at a time. Returns each scene's id, name, page count, last-updated time and (when published) its site slug. Pass `q` to search by name or slug instead of paging through a big account; page with the `nextOffset` the previous reply gave you. Use a scene id with get_scene and apply_ops.

offset.description: Skip this many results - page with the `nextOffset` the previous reply gave you.

q.description: Search text matched against the scene name and its published slug. Omit to list.

name: list_scenes
title: List 3dCMS scenes
